user.title: Connect to Telldus Live
user.description:
To let Home Assistant talk to your Tellstick, we need two application keys from Telldus.

**1.** Open {keys_url} in a browser (log in with your Telldus account).
**2.** Click **Generate a private API key** and fill in any title (e.g. *Home Assistant*).
**3.** Copy the **Public key** and the **Private key** from the row you just created and paste them below.

When you press Submit, Home Assistant will open a Telldus authorization page for you.

authorize.title: Authorize Home Assistant on Telldus
authorize.description:
Almost done. 

**1.** Tap this link — it opens the Telldus authorization page:

{authorize_url}

**2.** Log in if asked, then press **Yes** to grant Home Assistant access.
**3.** Come back here and press **Submit**.

error.invalid_keys: Telldus rejected the public/private key combination. Double-check that you copied both values from the same row at pa-api.telldus.com/keys/index.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Telldus Live. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.not_authorized: The request token has not been authorized yet. Open the authorization link, press **Yes**, then come back and press Submit.

abort.already_configured: This Telldus account is already set up in Home Assistant.
